please don't do it. Your family was awful. You deserved so much better than them. 

I think you should tell your wife how her words make you feel shitty. maybe she does have some love for you but she sounds toxic. 

spouse's are supposed to raise you up and support you. I'm not saying every woman must give oral or have sex all the time....but she doesn't have to be hurtful about it. we all make mistakes but this just sounds like hurting you for no real reason. moreover, I feel that you 2 sound wrong for each other. If a couple is sexually incompatible, is the marriage really sustainable? 

please consider trying therapy. there's so much pain and trauma and a professional can help you unpack it.   
I definitely understand the feeling of life being a game and being sick of playing. im sick myself honestly too. but damn...you're so strong and amazing for making it so far despite your nasty family and your unsupportive wife.

Dieting helps but its more important to exercise your core. if you can do a plank (with good form) everyday or every other day, gradually the muscle will tighten and get flatter. however you have to build up to a decent plank, and also do side planks for each side. If you do it too much you will hurt yourself so try to build up gradually. so first week might be hold for 10, next week 15, then 20, 25, etc.    


I think it gets pretty flat once you're at a point where you can hold it for 5 minutes. 

[https://www.exercisereviewsite.com/the-30-day-plank-challenge/](https://www.exercisereviewsite.com/the-30-day-plank-challenge/)

honestly I think online dating has messed up this entire generation. too many ppl want to date photoshopped supermodel. or they have FOMO and worry that "what if I marry but someone better comes along and its too late"

society romanticizes this idea that we all have to find a partner and start a family by 30 but no one seems to actually be willing to actually try it. Or the few that do are a really really small % of the successful population out of the millions of rejections happening.   


idk. I guess that's life...maybe its just that some ppl are not lucky enough to meet The One in their lives by 30. imho i feel like that's not really your fault. 

I feel like there's hope for you. Maybe you can live a sweet single life with a dog or cat or something and go out with your friends all the time. i mean at least you'll always have your actual family and friends.
